scenarios.name: caller promises a date and the platform ends the call
scenarios.description: The main branch: overdue bill found, a payment date recorded; promised is a terminal phase, so the line is said as written and the call ends without a hangup from the model.

expect.announce: Great, we'll expect your payment by this Friday. You can pay in the mobile app or at any service center. Thank you for your cooperation, goodbye.

scenarios.name: caller disputes the bill and is handed to a specialist

steps.say: That amount is wrong, I paid it already.

args.reason: says the bill was already paid

args.summary: Caller says the bill is paid.

scenarios.name: no overdue bill for the number
the answerer is not the owner
scenarios.description: hangup is tool-first: the global rule sends the call to the terminal finish phase, whose line apologises and says goodbye.

expect.announce: Sorry to have bothered you. Thank you, goodbye.

scenarios.name: the owner refuses to talk before any lookup
scenarios.description: The owner declines in greet, before bill_lookup (#147). The model must call hangup without saying goodbye itself; the global rule sends the call to finish, whose line mentions no payment because the identity is not established. Not finish_declined.

steps.say: 我是机主,我不想聊这个。

expect.announce: 不好意思打扰了,感谢配合,再见。

scenarios.name: caller refuses to talk about the bill
scenarios.description: hangup in remind is tool-first and goes to finish_declined, which names the payment channels.

expect.announce: 好的,不打扰您了。您也可以随时通过手机营业厅或线下网点缴费。感谢配合,再见。

scenarios.name: caller asks for a person at the reminder
a refused transfer keeps the call where it is
a tool from a later phase is refused
a model that keeps failing to transfer runs into the turn limit
scenarios.description: maxTurns is 20: the 21st tool result sends the call to need_transfer, the flow's fallback.

scenarios.name: model: owner promises to pay on Friday
scenarios.description: Tier 2. A cooperative account owner is reminded of an overdue bill and gives a payment date.

callerPersona.goal: Confirm you are the account owner when asked, listen to the reminder, and promise to pay this Friday. Then say thanks and goodbye.
callerPersona.persona: You are the owner of the account. You forgot to pay and are not upset.
